title: Generic constancy of a subsheaf of a constant finite sheaf
statement: Let $W$ be a nonempty irreducible scheme with generic point $\eta$, let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, let $M$ be a finite $\Lambda$-module, and let $\underline M$ be the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site $W_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. If $H\subset\underline M$ is a subsheaf of $\Lambda$-modules, then there are a nonempty open subset $W^\circ\subset W$ and a $\Lambda$-submodule $M'\subset M$ such that $H|_{W^\circ}=\underline{M'}$ as subsheaves of $\underline M|_{W^\circ}$.

source.place: Tag 03RY, Proposition 59.74.1(3), with Tag 03RZ, Lemma 59.71.6; proof paragraph under labels proposition-constructible-over-noetherian and lemma-constructible-abelian

proof.text: For each $m\in M$, let $W_m$ be the set of points $w\in W$ for which $m$ lies in the geometric stalk $H_{\bar w}\subset M$ (the identification with $M$ is the stalk of the constant sheaf). This condition is independent of the chosen geometric point over $w$. The set $W_m$ is open: if $m$ occurs in a stalk, represent it by a section of $H$ on an etale neighbourhood $V\to W$ of that point; after refining $V$, its image in the constant sheaf is the constant section $m$. The image of $V\to W$ is open because an etale morphism is flat and locally of finite presentation, so [lem-weil-pbc-flat-lfp-open] applies. These images, as the representing neighbourhood varies, cover exactly $W_m$.

source.place: Tag 03RZ, Lemma 59.71.6, proof paragraph under lemma-constructible-abelian

proof.text: Let $M'=\{m\in M:\eta\in W_m\}=H_{\bar\eta}$. Since $W$ is irreducible, every nonempty open contains $\eta$; hence each $W_m$ is either empty or contains $\eta$. Therefore $W^\circ:=\bigcap_{m\in M'}W_m$ is a nonempty open (the intersection is finite), and for every $w\in W^\circ$ the stalk $H_{\bar w}$ contains exactly the elements of $M'$: elements of $M'$ lie in all the $W_m$, while elements outside $M'$ have $W_m=\varnothing$. The inclusions of these stalks define the natural morphism of subsheaves $\underline{M'}|_{W^\circ}\to H|_{W^\circ}$; it is an isomorphism at every geometric stalk, so it is an isomorphism by [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative]. Thus $H|_{W^\circ}=\underline{M'}$ inside $\underline M|_{W^\circ}$.

lean.statement: theorem constant_subsheaf_generic (W : Scheme.{u}) [Nonempty W] [IrreducibleSpace W] (η : W) (_hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Finite M] (H : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (hH : H ⟶ (constantSheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) [Mono hH] : ∃ (U : W.Opens) (_hU : (U : Set W).Nonempty) (M' : Submodule Λ M), ∃ (e : ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj H) ≅ (constantSheaf U.toScheme.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (ModuleCat.of Λ M')), e.hom ≫ (constantSheaf U.toScheme.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (Submodule.subtype M')) = (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).map hH ≫ (Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).hom.app M
